description: Search MONETEKA's catalogue of Ukrainian coins and banknotes by name and facets. Each result carries the coin_id the other coin tools take.

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous page, with the same other arguments.
cursor.title: Cursor

kind.description: coin = commemorative coin, circulating = circulating coin, bullion = investment coin, banknote, souvenir, set, roll.
kind.title: Kind

person_id.description: id of a person from get_catalog_entity; only coins that credit this artist or sculptor.
person_id.title: Person Id

query.description: Words from the name, series or description, in Ukrainian; a nominal with a year works too («2 гривні 1996»).
query.title: Query

series_id.description: id of a series from get_catalog_entity; only coins of that series.
series_id.title: Series Id

sort.description: date = newest first (best matches first when a query is given); name = alphabetical.
sort.title: Sort

name: search_coins
title: Search the MONETEKA catalogue
